root_cause.text: A previous commit (ff6f0286c896) made the driver's init function unconditionally access the private data struct (host->priv), which was never allocated for old Rockchip SoCs (rk2928, rk3066, rk3188) because they lacked a parse_dt callback, leading to a NULL-pointer dereference.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Commit ff6f0286c896 ... makes the private data sort of mandatory, because the init function checks whether phases are configured internally or through the clock controller. This results in the old SoCs then experiencing NULL-pointer dereferences when they try to access that private-data struct." The patch adds a parse_dt function for rk2928 that allocates the private data and sets internal_phase = false.
